split.description: Use original NWB train/val/test labels and order. Validation training tensors use train; final test decoder training tensors use train+val. No random split or straight-reach subset.

inputs.description: Original NLB permits all 35 supplied same-trial held-in observation bins for co-smoothing and for predicting the ten unseen future bins. Test held-out spikes, future spikes and test behavior remain evaluator-only locally; original test targets have been public since January 2026. Original supplied training/validation spikes and behavior may guide fitting or selection, but the actual delivered fields, validation feedback, adaptation policy and budgets must be frozen before execution; this declaration grants no additional fields, trials or test-wide adaptation. Disclose behavioral guidance and distinguish it from matched neural-only learning. Author prefix bounds 0..max(t,13) and 0..min(t+17,34) are method-specific or separately named matched-access conditions, not primary offline candidate restrictions.

preprocessing.description: Original NLB1ms timestamps then20ms resampling;35observation and10forward bins. All original fields retained before native NaN-based row support. Memory-only complete-column scheduling preserves source timebounds, representative masks, Gaussian smoothing and trial/condition aggregation.

metric.description: Original co-smoothing Poisson log-likelihood improvement over per-neuron mean on evaluated counts, divided by total spikes and ln2; higher is better. Required companions: velocityR2,PSTHR2,forwardbps.

aggregation.description: Use the original scorer over the complete test panel with its original support and reductions, never a selected-trial/condition mean. Preserve both source rows and every companion metric separately for reproduction/calibration. Assess one full-panel primary offline candidate against the strongest qualified relevant source comparator selected before candidate results; do not average source arms or choose the weaker reference after seeing candidate output. The frozen comparison policy must record both published and qualified reproduced anchors; a lower reproduced point cannot silently replace a higher published result for a claim of surpassing the paper.

full_panel.description: Complete standard MC_Maze 20-ms panel: 182 neurons (137 held-in/45 held-out), original 1,721 train/574 validation/574 test trials, 108 source conditions, 35 observed and ten forward bins. Final decoder training uses all 2,295 train+validation trials. Require all eight Table 2 arm-by-metric findings and original nonempty-scored-condition support; 108 source conditions does not imply 108 scored PSTHs.

blocking_issues: DANDI000128/0.220113.0400 complete preparation is authenticated, but the 2024 source did not pin its data revision; historical printed-score/checkpoint-to-version linkage remains unresolved. Source-equivalent author replay is a calibration route and never counts as an AI reproduction outcome.

Retain both original author recipe definitions, source-filtered output choice and authenticated encoder-dependency proofs when reproducing their named findings. These proofs do not impose a primary offline candidate prefix restriction. Any explicitly claimed source-information-matched or strict-online result requires its own enforced boundary; source reflect-padding startup is not strict online. Actual materials, learning condition, adaptation policy and budgets still require prospective freeze.

Freeze a runnable AI analysis with authentic full inputs and independently rerun source-native complete train/eval rate tensors, ordered trial/neuron/bin identities, original decoder/condition/forward outputs and all eight original metrics. Copied Table 2 values, metadata-only shape checks and author-run receipts are insufficient.

Justify separate reproduction tolerances/uncertainty for all eight published point findings. Do not reuse the operator 0.01 diagnostic calibration tolerance, infer population replication from 32 Monte Carlo repeats, or collapse the two-arm vector into one scalar.

Freeze complete paired participant/evaluator/output-verifier identities and equal participant access/resource budgets. Existing source-only paired materials and operator calibration protocols do not establish AI execution, protected access or scientific reproduction.
Preserve public target-exposure disclosure and all original source support. No numerical targets or current scientific calibration results are read or inferred by this contract adoption.

The primary offline participant interface requires separate review and explicit successor binding; stale source-arm delivery or scoring metadata cannot be promoted by changing an outcome digest. No source finding, tolerance or qualification is changed.
